notes.title: Update 1.0.0f2
notes.content:
A small update to introduce new languages ​​to the game. We have added the following languages:

- Japanese
- Simplified Chinese
- Korean
- German

Thank you for your support, your feedback is very important!

notes.title: Update 1.0.0f1
notes.content:
In this update, we’re introducing a small improvement to help players find hidden items and boxes. A new button with a magnifying glass icon has been added to the top left corner of the screen. Clicking this button will highlight items and boxes that have not yet been found. However, there is a strategic limitation to its use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149081/81c29a503a443ef6fdb5434affea0764c64b2f4e.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] After using the highlight button, you will need to wait up to 5 minutes before it can be used again.
[*] However, for each item or box found while the highlight is active, the cooldown will be reduced by 30 seconds.
[*] Additionally, when you complete a level, an extra 1 minute will be deducted from the cooldown.
[/list]

This system is designed as an extra reward for players who actively explore and find items, allowing them to use the highlight feature more frequently as they progress through the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3160710/Loot_Stack__Relics_Hunter/

[h2] Thanks for playing![/h2]
